jobs.title: Salesforce Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 4+ years of experience. 4+ years of proven experience as a Salesforce Admin/Implementor in a technical Salesforce team At least 2 years of hands-on experience with Flows, including screen flows and record-triggered Flows In-depth understanding of Salesforce architecture, data model, and security model from hands-on experience with complex Salesforce projects

jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 6+ years of experience. 6+ years of backend engineering experience in Node.js with strong fundamentals and production experience Solid experience and understanding of distributed systems, including messaging, caching, microservice communication patterns, and failure modes Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure and comfort working across the AWS ecosystem

jobs.title: Platform Enablement & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 4+ years of experience. 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of features and projects from concept through production Broad full-stack engineering foundation with the versatility to work across the full stack rather than within a single narrow specialization Proficiency with a modern JavaScript/TypeScript stack (React on the front end, Node.js on the back end)
